facts.fact: A governance professional writing in The Namibian says there is currently no dedicated data protection authority in Namibia, and a draft bill expected to create a regulatory authority has not been enacted.
A governance professional writing in The Namibian says Namibia has no comprehensive data protection law in force and a draft data protection bill has been proposed but not enacted.
The writer says there is currently no dedicated data protection authority in Namibia.

NAM.note: The article only urges organisations to align with GDPR and South Africa's POPIA; it states no standards body membership or adopted standard.
